title: ScanConfig
description: Generated from shared/schema.ts by tools/gen-go-types.ts. Do not edit.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for editor support.

roots.description: Absolute roots to walk. Defaults to `[$HOME]`.

minFileSize.description: Files at or above this many bytes are reported individually.

minFolderSize.description: Folders whose recursive size is at or above this appear in the tree.

topNPerExtension.description: Cap on individually reported files per extension.

globalTopN.description: Cap on individually reported files overall.

workerCount.description: Worker threads used for the walk.

bundleExtensions.description: Directory extensions treated as one atomic item (`app`, `photoslibrary`).

categoryMap.description: Extension -> category. Extensions absent here fall back to `other`.

excludePaths.description: Absolute paths (or path prefixes) skipped entirely.

followSymlinks.description: Symlinks are never followed when false — cycles and double counting.

crossFilesystems.description: When false the walk stops at any `st_dev` change (mounts, network shares).

detectDuplicates.description: Second pass that fingerprints files sharing an exact size, to find byte-identical groups (APFS clones and real duplicates alike).

duplicateMinSize.description: Only files at or above this size are considered for fingerprinting.
